scope: Engine-local driving cap versus private/public migration metadata
initialHypothesis: A private ordinary/queue cap baseline might strand an inherited zero cap after migration. Do not treat this as established: engine guidance says forceSpeed needs reapplication on a new owner.

engineReferences.evidence: Main command contract gives m/s and negative reset; a2020 locality note says execute on actual owner and reapply after locality changes. Community note, not current live-engine evidence.
Locality note likewise says forceSpeed must be reapplied on owning client. No current HC test performed.

Distinguishes local effects and warns some MP commands such as netId do not work in singleplayer. Queue stable IDs/broker currently require distinct network identities; SP queue execution remains unproven/inactive.

sourceTrace: Ordinary DrivingAssist_State/Restore are private and not broadcast. Finite DrivingRecovery_Work carries public command/baseline/cap provenance but admission/release require current actual cap and command identity. Vehicle/crew init/Local hooks only offer existing pending reverse cleanup through bounded lookup; they do not replay reverse. Queue private consent is invalid under changed original owner/epoch; peers recheck canonical context in existing holds.
disposition: No public baseline transport or unconditional old-cap reapplication added. Corrected stale Repeat/JIP header that claimed private state resumed on a new owner. Actual owner transfer behavior must decide whether a reset-cap with continuing native command needs an explicit stop/handback path; do not lower ownership guards to make it adopt.
requiredLiveEvidence: Transfer ordinary positive safety cap and zero traffic/queue hold between real owners, read native cap before any CBE reapplication.
Transfer pending and acknowledged destination reverse and SIMPLE_BACK independently; capture whether native command/motion persists while cap resets.
Separate group, vehicle and crew locality ordering; repeat and transfer back to original owner.
Apply a newer mission cap/order during transfer; confirm cleanup preserves it.
Observe broker/peer hold retirement when ownership changes, without accepting old private consent.
implementationThisReview: Documentation/header accuracy only; no runtime commands, handlers, state publication or controller change.
limits: Audits paused. No claimed stuck-zero root cause, migration fix, HC acceptance or SP queue support. Full objective remains incomplete.
